verdict.rationale: Linear lists its own Figma integration, which lets designers create and link Linear issues directly from Figma without leaving the design tool. That covers the 'without switching apps' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows updating issue or project status from Figma; the integration documents only issue creation and linking, so it delivers only a thin slice of the story. Missing for 10: documented status updates from inside Figma, project-level status sync, detail on the integration's behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can keep project status updated from my design tool without switching apps
